content.text:
I've submitted index 5 (Sb fraction 0.397) as the best composition. At 0.0421% it had the highest EQE of the five I measured, but I can't confirm it's the best on the whole line. All EQE is very low, well under 0.1%.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.264 | 0.0098 |
| 3 | 0.330 | 0.0374 |
| **5** | **0.397** | **0.0421** |
| 8 | 0.502 | 0.0239 |
| 14 | 0.684 | 0.0005 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE is highest on the Pb-rich side, just below the Pb₂Sb₂O₇ composition (Sb 0.50). It drops steeply toward PbSb₂O₆ (Sb 0.67) and also falls at the most Pb-rich end.
- **How I picked index 5:** a parabola through the three best points put the maximum near Sb 0.397, and the GP model's suggestion agreed. I spent the last EQE measurement there.
- **What's untested:** the true peak could be at index 4 (Sb 0.362) or 6 (Sb 0.428), which I didn't measure. I also skipped everything above Sb 0.7 because EQE was falling so fast.
- **No XRD:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so which crystal phase gives the best performance is unconfirmed.
